Paramount Theatre’s new, intimate production of THE 25th ANNUAL PUTNAM COUNTY SPELLING BEE is absolutely Delightful in every possible way!

Aurora's Paramount Theatre delivered a breath of spring with its delightful revival of 'The 25th Annual Putnam County Spelling Bee,' a charming tuner about middle-school students vying for a chance to compete at The National Spelling Bee.
It offers audiences a joyous and heartfelt experience that lingers long after the final curtain call.
If you don't enjoy this one, you need to make a doctor's appointment.
This production of The 25th Annual Putnam County Spelling Bee is sure to please long time fans and new ones alike as the cast delivers on the fun and quirkiness of each of their characters.

cn.t: Critics enthusiastically praise this production as "fabulous" and "delightful," with some calling it among the best versions of the beloved musical. The cast delivers quirky, charming performances that please longtime fans and newcomers alike.
